finePrint.title: La malgranda presaĵo
finePrint.recordBody1: Mi ne havas enhavpolitikon kiu silente ĝisdatiĝas vendrede nokte. Mi ne decidas kio indas esti farita. Vi kaj viaj adorantoj decidas. Tio estas la tuta afero.
finePrint.recordBody2: Estas evidentaj limoj — kontraŭleĝa estas kontraŭleĝa — sed la platformo ne havas opiniojn pri arto.
finePrint.statusBody1: Ĝuste nun, Artypot subtenas nur <emph>kreditkartajn pagojn</emph>, kaj elpagoj povas iri nur al kreantoj kiuj estas <emph>bazitaj en Usono</emph>. Tio ne estas viziodeklaro — ĝi estas nur kie la jura paperaĵo nuntempe estas en ordo.
finePrint.statusBody2: Mi laboras pri tio. La celo estas fine tutmonda. Por nun: se vi estas adoranto ie ajn en la mondo, vi ankoraŭ povas subteni premiojn. Se vi estas tiu kiu ricevas pagon, vi bezonos usonan bankokonton.

commitments.title: 1. Devontigoj de la Kreanto
commitments.p0: Ŝaltante la kreantan reĝimon, vi formas devigan interkonsenton kun Artypot LLC, limigita respondeca kompanio de Florido, kaj konsentas pri la jeno.
commitments.p1Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You commit to producing the work described in a bounty in good faith and submitting it for review. Funds are only collected from fans after you submit your completed work and the Artypot Council confirms it satisfies the bounty — payment never precedes delivery. Submitting work you have not actually produced, do not own the rights to, or that does not fulfil the bounty may result in suspension or termination of your creator account.
commitments.p2Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] The social handles and websites you verify through Artypot must genuinely represent your identity as a creator. You must not impersonate another person or entity or misrepresent your affiliation with any platform account.
commitments.p3Lead: 1.3 Provizi precizajn impostajn informojn kiam petite.
commitments.p3Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] When your cumulative annual payouts reach IRS reporting thresholds (or equivalent thresholds under applicable local law), you agree to provide a completed W-9 (for U.S. persons) or W-8BEN (for non-U.S. persons) upon request. Failure to provide required tax documentation will result in a hard block on payouts until documentation is provided.
commitments.p4Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You must maintain an accurate country of tax residence (and U.S. state or territory, if applicable) in your creator profile. This information is used solely for earnings reporting and tax compliance purposes.
commitments.p5Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You are solely responsible for complying with all laws applicable to your activities on Artypot, including tax obligations, export controls, and local content regulations.
commitments.p6Lead: 1.6 Premioj financas publikan laboron, ne privatajn avantaĝojn.
commitments.p6Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] A backing is a contribution toward a public deliverable — it is not a purchase, and it does not entitle the backer to anything the general public does not also receive. You must not offer, promise, or provide any private, personal, or backer-exclusive benefit in exchange for a backing or in recognition of its size, including (without limitation) private access, one-on-one time, physical goods, personalized or backer-owned work, travel, in-person meetings, early or exclusive access, or any preferential treatment. The work you deliver for a bounty must be a single public result, equally accessible to backers and non-backers alike. The only recognition you may give a backer is a simple public acknowledgment of that individual by name, and only as a discretionary courtesy: a backer is never owed it, acquires no right to it, and has no claim if you choose not to give it. You may not scale recognition by backing size — no tiers, no leaderboard-style prominence, and nothing in which a larger backing buys greater visibility, such as naming the top backer in a video's title. Acknowledgment is for natural persons only: never a business name, mark, logo, URL, or promotional message. Auctioning or selling personal access or private benefits — for example, offering an experience to the highest backer — is prohibited, and converts a non-sale contribution into a transaction our platform and payment partners do not support.
commitments.p7Lead: 1.7 Neniu pago por oficialaj agoj aŭ kampanjoj.
commitments.p7Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] If you hold public office or are employed by a government, you may not accept or fulfil a bounty that rewards, induces, or is conditioned on anything you do in that official capacity. You also may not use Artypot to raise money for a political campaign, candidate, party, or committee, or for any other election-related purpose. This applies regardless of intent. Bounties for your ordinary creative work are unaffected — this is about official acts and campaigns, not about who you are.
commitments.p8Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Creator accounts are currently available only to individuals acting on their own behalf. Artypot does not yet support participation by corporations, LLCs, partnerships, or other business entities, and you may not enable or operate creator mode for or on behalf of any such entity. By enabling creator mode, you represent that you are a natural person, that you are acting solely on your own behalf and not for any business entity, and that your payouts will be reported under your personal taxpayer identity (such as a W-9 or W-8BEN, not an entity tax form). We expect to support business entities in the future; until we announce that support, entity-based participation is not permitted, and an account found to be operated by or for a business entity may have its payouts held or its creator status suspended until the matter is resolved.

role.title: 2. La Rolo de Artypot
role.p1Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Artypot is a platform that facilitates fan-funded commissions. Artypot is not your employer, client, agent, or partner. You are an independent creator. Nothing in these terms creates an employment, agency, joint venture, or partnership relationship between you and Artypot.
role.p2Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Artypot acts as a payment intermediary between fans and creators. Artypot collects fan backings, holds them in accordance with its billing and refund policies, and disburses net proceeds to creators after any applicable platform fees and processing costs.
role.p3Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Artypot does not guarantee that any bounty will reach any amount, that fans will fulfill their backings, or that any particular level of earnings will result from your participation.
role.p4Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Bounty completion submissions are reviewed by the Artypot Council, an independent body of verified users. Council decisions regarding approval or rejection of completions are final. There is no formal appeals process, though you may contact us to raise concerns about a decision.

payouts.title: 3. Elpagoj kaj Kotizoj
payouts.p1Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] To receive a payout you must: (a) have a verified country of tax residence on file; (b) have a connected payout account (via Stripe Connect where available, or another approved payout method); and (c) have provided required tax documentation (a W-9 for U.S. persons, or a W-8BEN for non-U.S. persons) as applicable.
payouts.p2Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Payouts are subject to a minimum balance threshold that depends on your country and payout method, as published on the Artypot website and shown in your creator dashboard from time to time. Balances below the applicable threshold will accumulate until the threshold is met.
payouts.p3Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Artypot deducts a platform fee from each payout, as specified in your creator dashboard and on the Artypot pricing page. Fees are subject to change with 30 days' notice to active creators.
payouts.p4Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Funds collected from fans are subject to a hold period (currently 7 days) before becoming available for withdrawal. This period exists to allow for fraud review and fan dispute resolution.
payouts.p5Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] All transactions are denominated in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated. You are responsible for any currency conversion costs incurred by you or your bank.

refunds.title: 4. Repagoj kaj Nuligoj
refunds.p1Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Fans may revoke open backings at any time before a bounty is marked complete. Revoked backings are returned to the fan in full; you are not entitled to compensation for revoked backings.
refunds.p2Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] If the Council rejects a completion submission, no funds are collected from fans. You may resubmit after addressing the Council's feedback.
refunds.p3Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] If a fan's bank reverses a charge (a chargeback), the disputed amount — net of the platform fee that was withheld from it — is deducted from your creator balance. This deduction applies whether or not the funds are still within the clearing hold period, and applies even if the funds have already cleared or been paid out to you. Where a single charge covers backings for more than one creator, a chargeback is allocated proportionally across the affected creators, and a chargeback for only part of a charge is clawed back proportionally. Because a chargeback can arrive after you have withdrawn the funds, this deduction may reduce your balance below zero (see 4.6). If a chargeback is later resolved in Artypot's favour, the deducted amount is restored to your balance.
refunds.p4Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Artypot may refund a fan, in whole or in part, at its discretion — for example to resolve a complaint, correct an error, address non-delivery or deficient work, or satisfy a legal or payment-partner requirement. When Artypot issues such a refund, the net amount you received for the affected backing is deducted from your balance and Artypot returns its own platform fee. As with a chargeback, this deduction may reduce your balance below zero. Artypot also reserves the right to claw back disbursed funds in cases of verified fraud or material misrepresentation.
refunds.p5a: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You may refund every backer of one of your own completed or paid-out bounties from your creator dashboard. Backings that have not yet been billed are cancelled at no cost to you. For backings that have already been charged, each fan is refunded the full amount they paid, and that full amount — including the platform fee — is deducted from your balance; because the refund is voluntary, Artypot does not return its fee on a creator-initiated refund. You may only start a bounty-wide refund when your available balance covers the full amount to be refunded. If it does not, contact
refunds.p5b: and we will help arrange it.
refunds.p6Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] A chargeback (4.3), an Artypot-initiated refund (4.4), or a clawback for fraud or material misrepresentation may reduce your creator balance below zero. A negative balance is carried forward and offset against your future earnings before any further payout is made. If you disable creator mode, close your account, or stop earning while carrying a negative balance, you remain responsible for the outstanding amount, and Artypot may recover it by any lawful means.
refunds.p7Lead: 4.7 Kompletaj ŝargoj estas finaj por la adoranto.
refunds.p7Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Once the Council confirms a completion and fans are charged, those charges are final and are not refundable at a fan's unilateral request. Refunds occur only in the cases described above: a chargeback (4.3), a refund Artypot elects to issue (4.4), a refund you choose to issue (4.5), or a clawback for verified fraud or material misrepresentation.
refunds.p8Lead: 4.8 Akcepto de nuliga risko; rezigno pri fid-pretendoj.
refunds.p8Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Backings on open bounties are expressions of intent, not guaranteed payments, and any backer may revoke, reduce, or withdraw a backing at any time before a bounty is confirmed complete (see 4.1 and 2.3). If you begin, perform, or complete work in anticipation of a bounty, you do so at your own risk and in reliance solely on your own judgment — not on any backing, projected total, or any representation by a backer or by Artypot. You expressly assume the risk that backings may be revoked, reduced, or never charged, and that a bounty may close or expire without any payment. To the fullest extent permitted by law, you waive and release any claim against any backer and against Artypot — including any claim for detrimental reliance, promissory estoppel, breach of an implied promise, lost profits, or the value of work performed — arising out of or relating to the revocation, reduction, or non-fulfilment of any backing before a bounty is confirmed complete.

content.title: 5. Enhavaj Reguloj
content.p1Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You must not submit, represent, or claim as your own any work that infringes the copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, or other intellectual property rights of any third party.
content.p2Lead: 5.2 La surfaco de Artypot estas por ĉiuj aĝoj.
content.p2Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Everything you publish or submit to Artypot itself — bounty descriptions and titles, your profile, display name, verified handles, comments, and the notes or links you attach to a completion — must be suitable for a general audience. This material is hosted and publicly displayed by Artypot, so it may not contain sexually explicit material, pornography, nudity, or gratuitous shock content. This is a rule about the on-platform surface; it is not a judgment about the legitimate creative work you produce and host elsewhere.
content.p3Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You may not use Artypot to solicit, coordinate, or collect payment for sexually explicit or pornographic work, whether or not the work itself is delivered off-platform. Artypot is the merchant of record for every bounty charge, and our payment partners (including the card networks and Stripe) prohibit processing payments for adult content. A bounty whose purpose is to fund adult content is therefore not permitted, regardless of where the finished work is hosted.
content.p4Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You must never submit, facilitate, represent as a completion, or use a bounty to fund any content that: (a) is illegal under applicable law; (b) constitutes harassment, a credible threat, or targeted hate speech; or (c) contains malware or malicious code. This prohibition is absolute and applies to both on-platform material and any work delivered off-platform in fulfilment of a bounty.
content.p5Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] For the material you publish or submit to Artypot itself (such as completion notes, links, and profile content), you grant Artypot a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to display, reproduce, and promote that material solely for the purpose of operating and marketing the Artypot platform.
content.p6Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You retain all ownership rights in your creative work. Nothing in these terms transfers copyright or other intellectual property rights to Artypot or to any fan.

termination.title: 6. Ĉesigo
termination.p1Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] You may disable creator mode at any time from your account settings, subject to any outstanding obligations (open bounties, pending payouts, or active disputes).
termination.p2Rest: [EO atendas profesian juran revizion — angla teksto] Artypot may suspend or terminate your creator status immediately if you: (a) breach these Creator Terms or the General Terms of Service; (b) engage in fraudulent or deceptive conduct; (c) fail to deliver work after funds are collected, repeatedly; (d) violate any applicable law; or (e) pose a risk to Artypot or its users.

bountiesJoined.info: Premioj kiujn vi aktive subtenas aŭ jam helpis liveri. La sublinio nombras tiujn kiujn vi mem komencis.

creatorsPetitioned.label: petitaj kreantoj
creatorsPetitioned.info: Apartaj kreantoj por kiuj vi subtenis premion. La sublinio estas kiom da ili sukcesis — liveris premion kiun vi subtenis kaj ricevis pagon de vi.

nextCharge.label: sekva ŝargo
nextCharge.info: Kion vi estos fakturita je la sekva fakturdato, kovrante premiojn kompletigitajn kaj aprobitajn ekde via lasta ŝargo. Vidu la plenan rompon sur la fakturpaĝo.

lifetimePaid.label: tutvive pagita
lifetimePaid.info: Kion vi efektive estis ŝargita, iam ajn. Ĝi restas $0 ĝis premio kiun vi subtenis estas liverita kaj aprobita — via karto neniam estas tuŝita ĝis kompletigo de la premio.

empty.message: Malkovru premiojn de kreantoj tra Artypot.

hero.body: Artypot estas premia platformo. Kreu premion por specifa projekto, dividu ĝin kun via spektantaro, kaj ili enmetas monon por ĝi. Neniuj abonoj. Neniuj pagmuroj. Vi faras la aferon, vi ricevas pagon. Se vi ne liveras, kreditkartoj neniam estas tuŝataj.

different.body: Vi jam scias kion volas via spektantaro... sed kiom forte ili volas ĝin? Artypot transformas iliajn "bonvolu fari X" komentojn en numeron kun dolarsigno antaŭ ĝi.
different.patreon: Monataj abonoj. Bonaj por kreantoj kun konstanta produktado — malfacile se via laboro venas en eksplodoj. Adorantoj pagas por aliro, ne por io specifa.
different.kofi: Malalta frikcio, sed ankaŭ malalta signalo. Trinkmonoj ne diras al vi kion iu vere volas farita. Ili estas dankemo por aferoj kiujn vi jam faris.
different.artypot: Adorantoj enmetas monon por unu specifa afero kiun vi volas krei. Nenio moviĝas ĝis ĝi estas finita. Vi ricevas pagon nur kiam vi liveras — kio estas ĝuste kial adorantoj komfortas enmeti veran monon.

card.title: Ilia karto ne estas ŝarĝata ĝis vi liveras
card.detail: Neniu livero signifas neniun pagon. Neniam. Tio igas subtenadon sentiĝi sekura.

oneThing.title: Ili subtenas unu aferon, ne monatan devontigon
oneThing.detail: Neniu abonkulpo. Ili enmetas monon por specifa afero kiun ili volas ekzisti.

backOut.title: Ili povas retiriĝi iam ajn antaŭ kompletigo
backOut.detail: Ŝanĝis sian opinion? Ili retiras sian subtenon. Neniaj malbonaj sentoj, neniu mono perdita.

worthMaking.title: Sciu ĉu valoras krei ĝin antaŭ ol vi kreas ĝin
worthMaking.detail: Malfermu la premion. Dividu ĝin. Se la subtenoj ne pravigas la laboron, nenio okazas kaj neniu perdis monon.

stayPublic.title: Via enhavo restas publika
stayPublic.detail: Ĉi tio ne estas pagmuro. Subtenantoj ne ricevas ekskluzivan aliron — ili ricevas la samon kiel ĉiuj aliaj, plus la kontenton esti farinta ĝin okazi.

payoutSchedule.title: Neniu platformo decidas vian pag-horaron
payoutSchedule.detail: Vi retiras kiam vi volas. La {billingDay}-a tago estas kiam adorantoj estas ŝarĝataj — post tio, la fondusoj liberiĝas post {waitDays} tagoj.

howPaid.label: La plena bildo
howPaid.title: de registriĝo ĝis banktransigo
howPaid.body: Ĉiu paŝo, en ordo. Neniaj surprizoj.

signUp.label: Registriĝu kaj fariĝu kreanto
signUp.sub: Ligu socian uzantnomon por ke ni povu konfirmi ke estas vi. Ni helpos se vi havas problemojn.

openBounty.label: Malfermu premion por via propra projekto
openBounty.sub: Skribu ĝuste kion vi volas krei — videon, albumon, ilustraĵan serion, ion ajn. Estu specifa. Svagaj premioj estas subtenataj malrapide.

share.label: Dividu la ligilon kun via spektantaro
share.sub: Afiŝu ĝin kie ajn estas viaj adorantoj. Ili povas subteni ĝin per du klakoj — neniu konto necesas por subteni, kvankam ili bezonos unu por pagi.

backingsComeIn.label: Subtenoj envenas (ankoraŭ neniu mono moviĝas)
backingsComeIn.sub: Adorantoj engaĝas sumojn. Nenio estas ŝarĝata. Vi povas rigardi la totalon kreski en reala tempo. Decidu kiam vi estas kontenta pri la rezulto.

makeThing.label: Faru la aferon
makeThing.sub: Laŭ via propra horaro. Neniu limdato krom se vi fiksas ĝin. Kiam ĝi estas finita, sendu ĝin de via panelo.

councilReviews.label: La Konsilio recenzas ĝin
councilReviews.sub: Malgranda grupo de homaj recenzistoj kontrolas ke via sendaĵo vere kongruas kun tio kion la premio petis. La simplaj solviĝas post kelkaj tagoj.

fansCharged.label: Adorantoj estas ŝarĝataj
fansCharged.sub: Kartoj estas ŝarĝataj je la {billingDay}-a tago de la monato post aprobo. Subtenantoj estas avertataj antaŭ ol ĝi okazas.

clearingWindow.label: {waitDays}-taga liberiga fenestro
clearingWindow.sub: Mallonga bufro por ke aperu iuj ajn disputataj ŝarĝoj. Norma praktiko de pagprilaborado.

withdraw.label: Eltiru al via banko
withdraw.sub: Vi konservas {creatorPct}% de tio kion adorantoj pagis. Transigu ĝin al via banko per Stripe Global Payouts.

fee.label: La kotizo
fee.title: {feePct}%. Fiksa. Ĉio inkluzivita.
fee.body1: Unu kotizo kovras ĉion — la funkciajn kostojn de Artypot kaj la tutan Stripe pagprilaboradon. Neniu monata kotizo por listigi premion. Neniu ŝarĝo se premio neniam kompletiĝas. Vi pagas nur kiam vi ricevas pagon.
fee.body2: Subtenantoj estas ŝarĝataj je sia ĝusta subtenita sumo. La kotizo eliras nur el via flanko, ne el ilia.

cta.titleLine1: elektu ion kion vi volas krei.
cta.body: Se via spektantaro volas ĝin, la mono aperos. Se ne estas sufiĉa subteno aŭ vi ne liveras, neniu pagas ion ajn.

hero.subtitle: Serĉu iun ajn kreanton, artiston aŭ publikan figuron — komencu premion kaj lasu la komunumon financi ĝin. Neniu liverado = neniu pago.

controller.title: 1. kiu regas viajn datumojn
controller.body: Artypot is operated by Artypot LLC, a Florida limited liability company ("Artypot," "we," "us," "our"). For questions about this policy, contact [EO: jura teksto — atendas profesian revizion]

account.label: Kontaj informoj:
account.body: Your name, email address, and password (hashed — we can't read it). Optionally: a profile picture and phone number for verification purposes. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]

financial.label: Financaj informoj:
financial.body: For backers: payment method details (processed by Stripe — see Section 5). For creators receiving payouts: bank account or payout-method information (processed by Stripe Connect or an alternative payout provider), and tax identification details for tax reporting (W-9 and 1099 for US creators; W-8BEN and 1042-S for creators outside the US). [EO: atendas profesian revizion]

activity.label: Agad-datumoj:
activity.body: Bounties you've created, bounties you've backed, bounties you've fulfilled, notifications you've received. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]

usage.label: Uz-datumoj:
usage.body: Standard server logs — IP addresses, browser type, pages visited, timestamps. We use this to diagnose problems, not to build marketing profiles. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]

comms.label: Komunikadoj:
comms.body: If you contact us via the support form or email, we retain those messages to resolve your request. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]

howUsed.title: 3. kiel ni uzas ĝin
howUsed.item1: Funkciigi la platformon — aŭtentigi vian konton, procesi pagojn, ekigi elpagojn
howUsed.item2: Sendi al vi transakciajn retmesaĝojn (pagkonfirmoj, ĝisdatigoj pri premioj, pagkvitancoj)
howUsed.item3: Plenumi jurajn devojn — impostaj raportoj (1099), fraŭdo-preventado
howUsed.item4: Plibonigi la platformon — identigi cimojn kaj uzadajn ŝablonojn agregite
howUsed.outro: Ni ne uzas viajn datumojn por reklamado, profilado aŭ vendo al triaj partioj.

sharing.title: 4. kun kiu ni dividas ĝin
sharing.intro: Ni dividas datumojn nur kun la servoprovizantoj necesaj por funkciigi la platformon:
sharing.stripeConnect: konfirmado de bankkontoj kaj elpagoj al kreantoj
sharing.dpa: Ĉiuj servoprovizantoj estas ligitaj de datumtraktadaj interkonsentoj. Ni ne permesas al ili uzi viajn datumojn por siaj propraj celoj.
sharing.legal: Ni ankaŭ povas malkaŝi datumojn kie la leĝo postulas, ekzemple responde al valida tribunala ordono aŭ alvoko.

payments.title: 5. pagdatumoj kaj stripe
payments.p1: All payment card data is handled directly by Stripe, Inc. When you enter your card details, that information goes to Stripe's servers — not ours. We never see or store your full card number, CVV, or expiry. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]
payments.p2: We store a Stripe customer ID and a reference to your saved payment method (e.g., last four digits, card type) so you can manage your billing. This reference is not sufficient to initiate a charge — only Stripe can do that on our instruction. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]
payments.p3pre: La privatecaj praktikoj de Stripe estas regataj de la
payments.p4: Creator bank account information is processed by Stripe Connect via Stripe Financial Connections. We store only a Stripe Connect account identifier — not the bank account number itself. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]

retention.title: 6. kiom longe ni konservas ĝin
retention.p1: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your personal information from active systems within 30 days. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]
retention.p2: Financial records (payment amounts, payout records, receipts) are retained for 7 years as required by US tax law, even after account deletion. These records are anonymised where possible. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]
retention.p3: Servilaj protokoloj estas konservataj ĝis 90 tagoj kaj poste forigataj.

children.title: 9. infanoj

international.title: 10. internaciaj uzantoj
international.p1: Artypot estas funkciigata el Usono. Se vi aliras la platformon de ekster Usono, viaj datumoj estos transdonitaj al kaj procesitaj en Usono. Uzante la platformon, vi konsentas al ĉi tiu transdono.
international.p2: We apply data protection measures consistent with US law. We do not currently have a formal EU Standard Contractual Clause (SCC) framework in place, but we will comply with any lawful data subject requests we receive. [EO: atendas profesian revizion]

changes.title: 11. ŝanĝoj al ĉi tiu politiko
changes.body: Ni povas ĝisdatigi ĉi tiun Privatecan Politikon de tempo al tempo. Ŝanĝoj estos reflektitaj en la dato "Laste ĝisdatigita" supre. Por gravaj ŝanĝoj, ni sciigos vin per retpoŝto aŭ tra la platformo.

acceptance.title: 1. Akcepto de la kondiĉoj
acceptance.p1: Artypot ("the Platform," "we," "us") is operated by Artypot LLC, a Florida limited liability company. By accessing or using Artypot, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.
acceptance.p2: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or back a bounty. By using the Platform, you represent that you meet this requirement.

description.title: 2. Kio estas Artypot
description.p1: Artypot is a bounty-style crowdfunding platform. Fans ("backers") pool funding toward specific tasks from public entities ("creators"). Backing is a commitment of funds, but no money moves when you back a bounty. Charges only occur after The Council reviews and confirms a bounty as complete.
description.p2: Artypot is not a tip jar, subscription service, or pre-order platform. It is a mechanism for coordinating demand signals and releasing payment only on delivery.

accounts.title: 3. Kontoj
accounts.p1: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and all activity that occurs under it. Do not share your login credentials.
accounts.p2: You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information when registering. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts with inaccurate or misleading information.
accounts.p3: One person, one account. Creating multiple accounts to circumvent restrictions is prohibited.

bounties.title: 4. Premioj
bounties.p1: Any registered user may open a bounty for any task a named creator could verifiably complete, subject to the Content Policy (Section 9). If it can be done, confirmed, and doesn't violate the Content Policy, it can be a bounty.
bounties.p2: Opening a bounty does not guarantee the named creator will fulfil it. The creator is under no contractual obligation to Artypot or to backers. A bounty is an expression of collective demand, not a contract with the creator.
bounties.p3Lead: A bounty funds public work, not private perks.
bounties.p3Rest: Backing is a contribution toward a result that is released publicly and equally to backers and non-backers alike. It is not a purchase of goods or services for the backer, and it confers no private benefit, ownership, exclusive access, or preferential treatment. Creators may not offer, and backers may not solicit or demand, any personal or backer-exclusive reward in exchange for a backing or its size — for example, private meetings, physical goods, personalized work, or an experience auctioned to the highest backer. The one form of recognition that remains permitted is a simple public acknowledgment of an individual backer by name, and only as a discretionary courtesy: a backer is never owed it, acquires no right to it, and has no claim if it is omitted, with the creator free to give or withhold it at their sole option.
bounties.p4Lead: No bounties for official acts or political campaigns.
bounties.p4Rest: A bounty may not reward, induce, or be conditioned on an official act — anything a government office holder or employee does, or could do, in their official capacity. Nor may a bounty serve as a contribution to or expenditure for a candidate, campaign, party, or committee, or otherwise aim to influence an election. Funding pointed at an official act or an election can create legal exposure for backers and for Artypot regardless of intent, so we don't allow it. This turns on the purpose of a bounty, not the identity of its subject: a public servant who is also a creator can still be the subject of a bounty for ordinary creative work. We may remove bounties that cross this line and take action on the accounts behind them.
bounties.p5: We reserve the right to remove any bounty at our sole discretion, including but not limited to bounties that are too vague, too difficult to verify completion, harmful, or illegal. We are not obligated to explain every removal, though we will attempt to provide a reason when possible.
bounties.p6: While we are committed to being reasonable, the creator a bounty is directed at may also remove that bounty at their sole discretion, for any reason or no reason.

backing.title: 5. Subtenado kaj pagoj
backing.p1Rest: When you back a bounty, no money moves and no authorization hold is placed on your card. Your card is only charged after The Council confirms a bounty is complete. Confirmed charges are collected together in a monthly billing run (on the 24th of each month), not instantly at the moment of approval.
backing.p2Rest: You may back out at any time before a bounty is confirmed completed by Council, even during the "pending review" stage.
backing.p3Rest: If your card cannot be charged when payment is due (expired card, insufficient funds, etc.), the charge fails and you will be notified. You then have a short grace period to update your payment method. While a failed payment is unresolved you cannot back new bounties, and if it remains unresolved your affected backings will be cancelled.
backing.p4a: You may cancel (revoke) any backing, free of charge and without giving a reason, at any time before The Council confirms the bounty complete — including while it is pending review. Once a bounty is confirmed complete, your backing is
backing.p4b: : it can no longer be cancelled, and it will be charged in the next monthly billing run. Charged payments are
backing.p4c: . We may, at our sole discretion, review a refund request after a charge in cases of genuine hardship or verified fraud —
backing.p4d: — but a post-charge refund is an exception we may grant, never an entitlement. This policy is also disclosed where you place a backing, in your backing confirmation email, in the pre-billing preview email, and on every receipt.
backing.p5Rest: If a bounty is closed or revoked before completion, no charges are made. Nothing was ever held against your card.
backing.p6Lead: Rajto de retiriĝo (EU, UK, kaj similaj konsumantaj jurisdikcioj):
backing.p6a: If you are a consumer in a jurisdiction that grants a statutory right of withdrawal from distance contracts (such as the EU under Directive 2011/83/EU or the UK under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013), you are hereby informed that, to the extent a backing or any resulting charge is treated as such a contract, you have the right to withdraw from it within 14 days of placing the backing, without giving any reason and at no cost. To exercise this right, cancel the backing from your
backing.p6b: , or notify us by an unequivocal statement to
backing.p6c: . Because no money moves until a bounty completes, withdrawal before completion simply means you are never charged. Note that Artypot's standard back-out right is broader than the statutory minimum: you may cancel any backing, free of charge, at any time before The Council confirms the bounty complete — even after 14 days.
backing.p6Bold: By placing a backing, you expressly request that performance begin before any withdrawal period expires, and you acknowledge that once the contract has been fully performed — that is, once The Council confirms the bounty complete and your card is charged — you lose your right of withdrawal.
backing.p6d: This disclosure is repeated in the confirmation email you receive when you place a backing and on each payment receipt.
backing.p7a: Payments are processed by Stripe, Inc. By backing a bounty, you also agree to
backing.stripeTos: la Kondiĉojn de la Servo de Stripe
backing.p8: If a fan disputes a charge for your work, the disputed amount may be deducted from your earnings.

creators.title: 6. Devoj de la kreinto
creators.p1: Creators who claim their profile and accept a bounty agree to deliver the specific work described in the bounty in good faith, as understood by their community.
creators.p2: Submission of a completion claim constitutes a representation that the submitted work satisfies the bounty description. Fraudulent submissions — submitting work that does not fulfil the bounty, or submitting work you do not own the rights to — may result in account termination and, where applicable, legal action.
creators.p3: Creators receiving payouts must provide accurate payment and tax information. US-based creators complete a W-9; creators outside the US complete a W-8BEN. Payouts are available in most countries — via direct bank payout where supported and alternative methods elsewhere — but are unavailable in countries we are legally restricted from serving. Artypot issues 1099 or 1042-S forms where required by law.

council.title: 7. La Konsilio
council.p1: The Council is a group of human reviewers appointed by Artypot. Their role is to verify that a submitted work actually fulfils the bounty before any funds are collected.
council.p2: The Council's decisions are final. There is no formal appeals process, though you may contact us to raise concerns.
council.p3: Council members are not liable for reasonable errors in judgment made in good faith during the review process.

fees.title: 8. Kotizoj
fees.p1a: When a bounty pays out, Artypot deducts a
fees.p1b: from the creator's payout. This single fee is all-inclusive: it covers Artypot's operating costs and all payment processing costs (including Stripe card transaction fees). Creators always receive 80% of the total amount backed.
fees.p2: Backers are charged their exact committed amount — no processing surcharges are ever added to a backer's charge.
fees.p3: Fee rates may change with notice. Changes apply to bounties opened after the effective date of the change.

content.title: 9. Enhava politiko
content.p1Lead: La surfaco de Artypot estas por ĉiuj aĝoj.
content.p1Rest: Anything you publish or post to the Platform itself — bounty titles and descriptions, profile text, display names, verified handles, comments, and the notes or links you attach to a completion — is hosted and publicly displayed by us and must be suitable for a general audience. It may not contain sexually explicit material, nudity, pornography, or gratuitous shock content. This is a rule about what appears on Artypot; it is not a judgment about the lawful creative work a creator produces and hosts elsewhere.
content.p2Rest: You may not use a bounty to request, commission, coordinate, or fund sexually explicit or pornographic work, whether or not the finished work is delivered off-platform. Artypot is the merchant of record for every charge, and our payment partners (including the card networks and Stripe) prohibit processing payments for adult content. A bounty whose purpose is to fund adult content is therefore not permitted, regardless of where the work is hosted.
content.p3Rest: The following are never permitted on the Platform or in any work funded through it, and apply regardless of where the work is hosted:
content.item1: Content that is illegal under US federal or state law
content.item2: Bounties that pay for an official government act or function as a political campaign contribution (see Section 4)
content.item3: Harassment, credible threats, or targeted hate speech
content.item4: Malware, malicious code, or attempts to compromise the Platform or its users
content.p4: We reserve the right to remove any content and suspend or terminate any account that violates this policy, at our sole discretion and without prior notice.

ip.title: 10. Intelekta proprieto
ip.p1: Artypot does not claim ownership of any content created by creators in fulfilment of bounties. The creator retains all rights to their work.
ip.p2: Backers who fund a bounty receive no special rights to the finished work — they receive the same access as the general public. Artypot is not a commissioned work platform.
ip.p3: By posting content to Artypot (e.g., bounty descriptions, profile text), you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to display that content on the Platform.

termination.title: 11. Ĉesigo
termination.p1: You may delete your account at any time from your settings page. Deletion cancels all active commitments (no charges) and removes your public profile.
termination.p2: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms, engage in fraud, or abuse the Platform. In cases of serious violations, we reserve the right to take action without notice.

disclaimer.title: 12. Malgarantioj
disclaimer.p1: Artypot is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the Platform will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that any bounty will be fulfilled.
disclaimer.p2: We are not responsible for the actions of creators, backers, or third parties.

liability.title: 13. Limigo de respondeco
liability.p1: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Artypot and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Platform.
liability.p2: Our total liability to you for any claim arising from these Terms or your use of Artypot shall not exceed the total amount you have paid to Artypot in the 12 months preceding the claim.

governing.title: 14. Reganta leĝo
governing.p1: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Florida, United States, without regard to conflict of law principles.
governing.p2: Any disputes arising from these Terms shall be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Florida. You consent to personal jurisdiction in those courts.

changes.title: 15. Ŝanĝoj al ĉi tiuj kondiĉoj
changes.p1: We may update these Terms from time to time. When we do, we'll update the "Last updated" date at the top. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
changes.p2: For material changes, we'll make reasonable efforts to notify you by email or via the Platform.
